plan.selection: Rank April 29–August 26 mean return after 9 bps friction, minimum 30 trades. Freeze the best three before fetching January 1–April 28 data. Report all 32 variants, including losses.
plan.validation: August 27–October 25 is previously inspected comparison data. January 1–April 28 is an unseen earlier-period robustness check, not chronological forward validation. No further tuning after checking it.
plan.limitations: OHLC fills, stop first if both exits hit, fixed 9 bps trading friction, funding excluded, no gamma or trend filter, not a complete discretionary trading model.

venueCosts.scope: Published standard-tier perpetual taker rates applied to the same Deribit reference candles; not venue-native execution backtests. Account tiers unverified. Funding and size-dependent impact excluded. One bp per side spread/slippage is assumed.
